name: Akari Kito
bio: Hailing from Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture, Akari Kito is known as a voice actress and singer for anime, video games, and more. She is best known for voicing Nezuko Kamado in "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba", Suzune Horikita in "Classroom of the Elite", and Nene Yashiro in "Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun".
